---
title: "Our Story"
---

We are nine academics who have spent around 20 years producing work together, debating and learning from one another across different universities in labour economics, industrial relations and social policy.

During these years, we have contributed to numerous national and international books, articles, research studies and projects. Our experiences in different universities, academic environments and research fields have made one point increasingly clear: knowledge about working life and social policy needs to reach beyond academia. It must be produced and shared with close attention to current developments, social needs and the future.

We believe in connecting scientific knowledge with everyday life. While addressing Türkiye’s working life and social policy challenges in their distinctive context, we also follow global developments closely. We believe in supporting high-quality academic work and researchers who can contribute to debate nationally and internationally.

For a long time, we had discussed a shared ambition: to create an environment where academics, early-career researchers, students and everyone committed to these fields could meet, discuss ideas freely, strengthen a culture of joint research and connect with national and international academic networks.

ÇAHSPAR emerged as a concrete expression of that ambition.

We came together again to pool the academic experience we had built over the years, support new researchers, strengthen scientific output in working life and social policy and become part of a stronger academic ecosystem connecting Türkiye with the world.

We envisage ÇAHSPAR as a platform for research and academic work, and as an environment for thinking, creating, sharing and developing knowledge together.

Drawing on our experience, we look towards the future and set out to produce stronger, higher-quality and more influential research in working life and social policy.

We know that knowledge grows when it is shared, and ideas develop when we create them together.

## Our Development

- Identifying gaps in knowledge about social policy and working life
- Developing academic and institutional partnerships
- Delivering practice-oriented training and projects
- Creating space for public awareness and participatory policies

As it develops its institutional identity, ÇAHSPAR seeks to produce long-term, inclusive solutions alongside responding to current challenges.
